note: The refusal and state names of the anchored certify form (evidence 2.1 links, RB9-F5 section 3). The Go constants (pkg/proof/v2/certify_names.go) and the TypeScript constants (packages/verify/src/s3/certify-names.ts) are generated from, and tested against, this file. A refusal is rendered as name{field,field}: detail, fields in the order listed, integers in decimal and hashes as lower-case hex. index is the ordinal of the link in the document's links member for the three certify_link_* names, and the position of the item in certify followed by check.hops for certify_item_without_effect. A detail is fixed text and never interpolated.

names.name: certify_link_missing
names.detail: an anchored item has no link

names.name: certify_link_start
names.detail: the link does not start at the previous verified root chain anchor

names.name: certify_link_end
names.detail: the link does not end at the item's root chain anchor

names.name: certify_link_invalid
names.detail: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item

names.name: certify_link_unavailable
names.detail: no receipt links the previous root chain anchor into the item's root chain height

names.name: certify_update_replayed
names.detail: the update was already applied earlier in the walk

names.name: certify_item_without_effect
names.detail: an anchored item that is not the last of its sequence carries no update

names.name: certify_update_unproven
names.detail: the update's root chain position does not lie between the previous and this anchor's root chain index

names.name: certify_window_unaccounted
names.detail: the account's main chain holds writes the walk did not account for

names.name: certify_range_unavailable
names.detail: the Directory does not serve the minor-root range; retry

names.name: certificate_budget
names.detail: the certificate does not fit the transaction size limit (tx_too_large)

names.name: checkpoint_stale
names.detail: the evidence builds on a major block older than the newest verified one by more than the allowed lag
